result:
No actions yet. There's no project to read beyond the spreadsheet description, and the main gap is why the spreadsheet isn't working for you.

---

Thanks for sharing the spreadsheet layout. Right now each row records one loan: which seed, how many packets, who took them, when they went out, and when they came back. About a third of the rows have no return date.

Before I suggest anything, I'd like to understand what's going wrong with it today. That will decide what the new system is mostly built around. It might need to make lending quicker, make returns easier to record, help follow up with people, or show what's on the shelf.

**When the spreadsheet lets you down, what's actually happening? Tell me about a recent time it didn't give you the answer you needed.** Those empty return dates are part of what I'm curious about, in whatever way they matter to you.
